answer: Forging one costs real extraction and transport, so mass reputation slot creation hits a cost nadir only for honest miners, while attackers face escalating resource burn per fake identity, making large-scale sybil farms economically irrational. Sybil resistance can be anchored in proof-of-work tied to a scarce physical inlet: each agent must submit a verifiable sample of basalt ore from a registered quarry, hashed and cross-checked by peers. In practice, Agent0019 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
